notes.title: Tinyfolks 1.4 Boss Rush Update!
notes.content:
[h1]OMG the dev is still working on this ?![/h1]
Hey everyone, I'm glad to present the brand new update for Tinyfolks.
This update contains the following :
[list]
[*] [b]Boss Rush Challenge Mode[/b] : Try this extra challenging mode where you only get to fight the bosses, no more feeble minions to warm up your team! Will you be able to beat the Evil Sorcerer if you are not able to farm feeble goons for resources?
[*] Achievement bug fixes : all achievements should be accessible to unlock. This has been an issue for a while, but everything should work now
[*] Some bug fixes on baby mode (cradle didn't work as intended)
[/list]

I would like to appologize for the lack of updates recently, here are a few reasons this took so long :
- Last year I was pretty busy working as a small shop owner in my community. This obviously took a lot of my energy, and I just could'nt find enough free time to work on game dev projects. I stopped doing that a few months ago, and I just got out of the French paperwork, so I'm back in front of the computer and will be resuming my work on all of my game dev projects!
- I have a big game in the works called Rootown, on wich I have been spending a lot of time. Obviously this meant that Tinyfolks was not my highest priority anymore.
- To be totally honest, it's hard to go back on a 3 years+ old project when you have other fun things to work on ^^

[h1]Unrelated news : Orb Tower[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42162054/ca4b1765473c052791123086c7c5490bcd1086d5.png[/img]
I just released the steam page for a brand new project that should be coming out really soon called [b]Orb Tower[/b] and I'm really excited to share it with you.
In short, it's a Roguelike version of the arcade classic Puzzle Bobble, with cool pixel art graphics and tons of different challenge modes, bosses, items, achievements etc... Enough to keep you entertained for hours if you dig that kind of game!

The game should come out in a few weeks, but you can already wishlist the game to be notified as soon as it comes out. As always, wishlisting the game is one of the best way you can help me!

You can find it here : [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3496500/Orb_Tower]Orb Tower Steam Page[/url]

[h1]What About Rootown?[/h1]
Don't worry, I'm still working on it, even if I didn't share any updates about it recently on Steam, I have been making video content about my progress on [url=https://www.youtube.com/@vandermaesengames9151]Youtube[/url] and [url=https://www.tiktok.com/@pyairvander]TikTok[/url] as well as sharing my developement process on [url=https://www.twitch.tv/pyairvander]Twitch[/url]. The game is coming along nicely, even if the shopkeeping buisness slowed down things a lot last year. Expect some cool news on this in about a month!


[h1]As always, thank you so much[/h1]
I'm really happy to see people are still enjoying Tinyfolks three years after its launch, and I'm really glad I'm finally able to spend more time making games now. Have fun with the new challenge, and take care ❤️

Pierre

notes.title: 1.3.4 Patch (Mark Marcusons bug)
notes.content:
Just a quick patch to fix the game breaking bug during combat, forgot a small detail in the build that completely breaks the game.
This is now fixed on Windows and Linux, making the Mac build right now (but it's taking a bit longer since I have to boot up my old Macbook pro to make the build)

notes.title: 1.3 UPDATE : BABY MODE
notes.content:
Hi all!

To celebrate an entire year of Tinyfolks being out in the world, I made a game mode where the king has been replaced by a 1 year old baby!
It's a completely different game mode, where the baby must be in all combats, and if it dies, the game ends! This should be quite a challenge!

On another note, I've been working hard on a little project called "Spacefolks", and I will keep you posted about it later this year.

This update includes a bunch of small bug fixes, so the game should be as smooth running as possible!

As always, thank you so much for playing :)
Cheers

Pierre

notes.title: CIRCUS UPDATE, Android release and a new game!
notes.content:
Hi folks!

After a bit of a hiatus, I'm pleased to share what I've been working on for the past few months!

[h1]TINYFOLKS 1.2 : CIRCUS UPDATE[/h1]
New folk classes and challenge mode, all based around the troubadour class! Thew come with new weapons and abilities never seen before in the game!

I also added a new challenge mode that allows you to have fun with the new classes, I hope you'll like it!

[h1]ANDROID RELEASE[/h1]
The game is now available on the Google Play store! If you wanted to take your folks on the go, it's now possible!
[url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.VandermaesenGames.Tinyfolks]GET THE GAME ON GOOGLE PLAY[/url]

[h1]NEXT GAME : ROOTOWN[/h1]
I've started work on my next game : ROOTOWN, a cute and chill tree growing/farming sim. You can already wishlist it on steam! I'm planning to release the game by July if all goes according to plan!
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2319400/Rootown]CHECK OUT ROOTOWN ON STEAM[/url]

[h1]A BIG THANK YOU[/h1]
As always, thank you all for your support! I'm trying to scale up my one-man studio and get funding to hire some cool game devs and pixel artist friends of mine. As I'm working on a new game, I can't say when I'll be adding new content to Tinyfolks, but I'll at least try and get the game on iOS in the next few months!

Love

Pierre

notes.title: TINYFOLKS 1.1 : MONARCH UPDATE
notes.content:
Hi Folks!

The update has been sitting in the pre-release stage for a bit now, and I feel like it's time to get it out in the "real" world!

[h1]1.1.1 Update changelog[/h1]
- You can now train your ruler!
- 3 new biomes + a secret biome!
- Very Hard Mode : monsters are tougher!
- 2 new game modes with brand new classes and gameplay!
- New abilities + meta!
- UI improvements!
- You can now sell components like mushrooms
- Loot and costs re-balancing
- Codex feature recording all classes/items/monsters you discover
- New achievements
- Changes to the statuses / weaknesses features

[h1]OST is here[/h1]
The OST is finaly available for purchase! It includes all the tunes in the games + a special instrumental version of the town theme.
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2052840/Tinyfolks_Soundtrack]TINYFOLKS OST[/url]

[h1]What if I want to play the old version?[/h1]
The 1.0.7 version has been kept on the 1.0.7 branch, so you can always go back whenever you feel like it ^^ (remember to make backups of your save fils when going back in time)

[h1]What's next ?[/h1]
Jump over on Discord to keep in touch, share your thoughts and be notified when new updates are in the works! [url=https://discord.gg/gVtgr8apxc]Join the official Discord[/url]


Love

Pierre

notes.title: Tinyfolks 1.1.0 pre-release!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42162054/b923348c83e207c2f89c8778390f368ba3f299a0.gif[/img]

Hi all!

Thank you so much for the enthousiasm around the 1.1.0 update! I've been working hard for the past 6 weeks to give you an amazing update, packed with new challenges, features, folks and music!

The game is currently being tested by a bunch of friends, but I think I should let the community get their hands on it as well! I'll be closely listening to feedback on the Steam community dashboard and on the brand new Discord server as well

[h1]WHY MAKE A PRE-RELEASE?[/h1]
I figured this would be the best way to gather feedback about the new features before making them the default option. Since this is a pretty major update, I really want you to have a say on what it brings to the game.

[h1]HOW TO GET THE PRE-RELEASE[/h1]

[b]To make the job a little easier for me, the 1.1.0 prerelease is only available on Windows at the moment[/b]
The 1.1.0 BETA version is currently on the [u][b]prerelease[/b][/u] branch of the game. To access this branch : 
[olist]
[*]Right-clic on the game's name in your Steam Library
[*]Go to Settings > Betas
[*]Select the "prerelease" option in the dropdown menu
[*]Type the password : "tinyprerelease"
[/olist]
[b]WARNING : this is a pre-release version and might not be perfectly stable. You're at risk of loosing game progress (not your achievements). You can make a backup of the save files, they're located in the main game file directory.[/b]

[h1]NEW DISCORD SERVER[/h1]
As it has been suggested multiple times, I've decided to create a Discord server for our community. This is the best place to reach out to me, talk about the game and share cool new strats.
You can reach the server by clicking this link : [url=https://discord.gg/gVtgr8apxc]https://discord.gg/gVtgr8apxc[/url]

[h1]TINYFOLKS OST[/h1]
The OST is finished, including all the new music added in the 1.1.0 update, and will be out as soon as the Steam verification process is over (usually a few days)

[h1]TRANSLATION[/h1]
Only the English language has been verified, but I decided to make the text file containing all the text in the game availables directly in the game files. This way, adding new languages and / or fixing spelling error will be A) faster for me B) easier for anyone to do.
I'm still speaking with a few kind translators, but If you want to help as well, feel free to reach out in the Discord !


[h1]NEW ACHIEVEMENTS ??[/h1]
I had to create new achievements to accomodate the 1.1.0 update. Most are not available to unlock in the current official 1.0.7 version.


I will do a proper changelog once the 1.1.0 update is officially released (next week if everything goes well), until then, have fun, and feel free to reach out about anything regarding the new update, I'm really looking forward to hear your thoughts on it !

Love

Pierre

notes.title: 1.0.5 Changelog - New class and rename your folks!
notes.content:
Hi all !

I've been pretty busy tracking down bugs and overall managing the launch, but planning to start adding new features and content soon ! I'm thinking about adding a codex, new town activities, new biomes and ways to upgrade the ruler, stay tuned ;)

Changelog

[list]
[*] Added a new folk class ! Go find it at the tavern ;)
[*] You can now rename your folks by clicking the pen icon in the population UI.
[*] Fixed the "final boss not dying in folk mode" bug, again, very sorry about this one.
[*] Fixed invetory stacks being replaced when unequiping an object.
[*] Changed the "Simple" achievement requirements. Now instead of beating the game without upgrading a building, you only need to beat the game with a max population of 6 or less.
[*] Fixed bugs where applying the Defense Rune and/or improving a folk's armor made him hurt.
[*] Fixed a slight error in the final boss AI
[*] Fixed some typos in FR/EN (IT, ES and DE versions are being worked on)
[*] Fixed a soft lock when using thieves against the ruins boss
[/list]
